name: Scapholunate Ligament Injury
definition: Injury of the scapholunate interosseous ligament causing carpal instability and potential progression to scapholunate advanced collapse arthritis.

investigations.principle: Stress radiographs and MRI/MR arthrography may help; arthroscopy is the reference assessment in selected cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Complete or unstable injuries may require surgical repair/reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the scapholunate interosseous ligament causing carpal instability and potential progression to scapholunate advanced collapse arthritis.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
